<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex4022024-09-1315-23-40" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Scribe's colophon – Story of the copy (118a5–118b3)"/>
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4134">rje klong rdol rin po che</rs> nas phran <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4132"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4134">klong rdol</rs> drung yig</rs> la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3806">rje gro lung pa</rs>'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4468">bstan rim chen po</rs> 'di'i par zhig byung na brko rogs gyis gsungs kyang || phran rang nyid sngon bsags kyis sbyin 'bras phra bas gser dngul sogs kyi mthun rkyen <lb edRef="inst:4470" n="118a6"/> 'dzoms dka' bas tshe 'dir 'grub pa'i re ba dang bral zhing ||</seg></TEI>
